items.title: Solana speeds up blocks by 17%, but transaction capacity stays the same
items.whyYouShouldCare: The 17% increase in block speed enhances Solana's efficiency, but maintaining transaction capacity indicates potential limits on scalability and user demand.

items.title: Mapping Pi Network’s 15% decline – 3 signals point to more downside
items.whyYouShouldCare: The 15% decline in Pi Network signals potential ongoing weakness, which could impact broader market sentiment and liquidity for related projects.

items.title: Your crypto hardware wallet can stay secure while everything around it fails
items.whyYouShouldCare: The resilience of crypto hardware wallets amid market volatility underscores their importance in securing assets, potentially boosting user confidence in the Solana ecosystem.
